code:

  10.0.2.0/24  -> private subnet  (app servers)
  10.0.3.0/24  -> private subnet  (database layer)
caption: Same subnetting math from Chapter 1, now applied inside the cloud.

code:
Public subnet route table:
  10.0.0.0/16 -> local
  0.0.0.0/0   -> internet gateway

Private subnet route table:
  10.0.0.0/16 -> local
  (no route out to the internet)
caption: A route to an internet gateway is the real definition of "public."
